screenSpaceIntent.direction: upper-left rear three-quarter, 25–35 degrees from straight rear
screenSpaceIntent.core: narrow capsule with top center 5 px screen-left of foot center
screenSpaceIntent.earPlanes: screen-left ear visibly reprojected toward profile; screen-right ear smaller and receding
screenSpaceIntent.valuePlanes: screen-left near plane slightly lighter; screen-right back plane darker, flat values only
screenSpaceIntent.exclusions: no paws, equipment, full face, second eye or mane seam
screenSpaceIntent.tail: tail mass must be on screen-right
screenSpaceIntent.faceCue: one tiny eye and minimal nose/muzzle edge may appear only on screen-left outline
